info.title: AI Support Assistant API
info.description: Generated from the Smithy model in spec/model. Do not edit by hand.

post.description: Exchange username + password for a token set. Public.
Revoke the session family of a refresh token. Public; unknown tokens are ignored.

get.description: Returns the user identified by the bearer token.

post.description: Rotate a refresh token into a new token set. Public (the refresh token is the credential).

get.description: The active guideline version with its extracted text and chunks.

put.description:
Upload (or replace) the guideline file for a company. Processing is
asynchronous: returns 202 with the new version in `queued` status; poll
GetGuidelineVersion until it is `ready`, `failed` or `superseded`.

parameters.name: X-Expected-Version
parameters.description:
Id of the latest guideline version the client displayed. If a newer
version exists the upload is rejected with GuidelinesConflictError.

schema.description:
Id of the latest guideline version the client displayed. If a newer
version exists the upload is rejected with GuidelinesConflictError.

parameters.name: X-File-Content-Type
parameters.description: Original MIME type as reported by the browser, if known.

schema.description: Original MIME type as reported by the browser, if known.

parameters.name: X-Filename
parameters.description: Original file name (extension is used to pick the parser).

schema.description: Original file name (extension is used to pick the parser).

get.description:
Lists the calling agent's own conversations, newest activity first. Conversations are private
to the agent who started them.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for paginated list operations (opaque to clients).

schema.description: Cursor for paginated list operations (opaque to clients).

get.description:
Returns the conversation with its newest messages (chronological order). Long threads are
paged: pass `before` (the `olderCursor` of a previous page) to load the messages preceding it.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Load messages older than this cursor (from a previous page's `olderCursor`).

schema.description: Load messages older than this cursor (from a previous page's `olderCursor`).

post.description:
Append a customer message or an agent instruction and get the assistant's
guidance. Both the user message and the assistant message are persisted,
even when the AI provider fails (assistant message has status `failed`).

get.description: Status + progress of one version. Poll while status is not terminal.

post.description: Make a `ready` version the active one (rollback / conflict resolution).

put.description: Rate an assistant message. A thumbs-down requires the corrected answer.

AiProviderErrorResponseContent.description: The AI provider failed or timed out. Safe to retry.

AssistantGuidance.description: Structured guidance produced by the assistant for the agent.

recommendedReply.description: Customer-facing draft; placeholders like [Name] are left for the agent.

handlingSteps.description: Internal steps for the agent, in order.

clarifications.description:
Questions the customer must answer before the case can be resolved
(preferences, missing details). Optional for older messages.

agentDecisions.description: Decisions the guidelines leave to the agent's judgement (never questions for the customer).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

Correction.description: A stored piece of feedback, used as a few-shot correction for future answers.

queryText.description: The customer message that led to the flagged answer.

active.description: Inactive corrections are not retrieved (e.g. tied to replaced guidelines).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

FeedbackSummary.description: Feedback the current or another user left on an assistant message.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

olderCursor.description: Present when older messages exist; pass it as `before` to load them.

GuidelineStatus.description: Lifecycle of an uploaded guideline file.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

readyAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

GuidelinesConflictErrorResponseContent.description: Another user uploaded guidelines after the client loaded the page.

uploadedAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

time.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

nextCursor.description: Cursor for paginated list operations (opaque to clients).

content.description:
Raw text for customer/instruction messages; the recommended reply for
assistant messages (full structure in `guidance`).

promptTokens.description: Tokens in the prompt (system instruction, history, retrieved context).

completionTokens.description: Visible answer tokens, excluding the model's reasoning.

thinkingTokens.description: Reasoning ("thinking") tokens; billed as output but not part of the answer.

totalTokens.description: Total tokens billed for the call as reported by the provider (prompt + thinking + answer).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

TokenSet.description:
Short-lived access token (JWT, sent as Bearer) plus a long-lived, single-use refresh token.
Reusing a rotated refresh token revokes the whole session family.

accessExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

refreshExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time (restJson1 would otherwise default to epoch seconds).

ValidationExceptionField.description: Describes one specific validation failure for an input member.

path.description: A JSONPointer expression to the structure member whose value failed to satisfy the modeled constraints.

message.description: A detailed description of the validation failure.

ValidationExceptionResponseContent.description:
A standard error for input validation failures.
This should be thrown by services when a member of the input structure
falls outside of the modeled or documented constraints.

message.description: A summary of the validation failure.

fieldList.description:
A list of specific failures encountered while validating the input.
A member can appear in this list more than once if it failed to satisfy multiple constraints.
